topic.title: Career as a matrimonial rewards programme
topic.claim: We all think hard work should come with a spec sheet for the partner, and the unicorn list runs both ways.
topic.behaviour: Treating a salary as entitlement to a partner who's attractive, fit, liberal and rich, while calling the other side picky.
topic.mechanism: Marriage is still a market where achievement is the currency. If you've sacrificed for the career, you want the receipt.
real_details: A viral post sarcastically asked where the reward wife is after slogging for a career
The author argued relationships aren't compensation for sacrifice
Commenters said women with ₹30L plus incomes also hunt for unicorns
Others argued preferences aren't wrong, just honesty about past relationships matters
One commenter joked about wanting a 50 lpa, tall, not bald partner
topic.why_now: The thread topped the sub this month and split commenters cleanly down the middle.

score.reason: Sharp, emotionally loaded marriage-market angle with a top-ranked thread and genuine two-sided split
score.best_hook: I slogged for ten years to build a career. Where's my hot, unspoiled, large-hearted spouse? A lot of you are asking this out loud now.
